integrity: Proof and finite checks provided; no claim of independent verification or exhaustive proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The operator acts only on the zonal/one-variable polynomial space of degree less than \(2m\), not on the full spherical-harmonic space.
The theorem controls the product of centered eigenvalue magnitudes, not individual eigenvalues or eigenvectors.
The uniform asymptotic error has a proved order but no optimized explicit numerical coefficient.
The Jacobi moment determinant evaluation and Barnes asymptotics are established classical ingredients; the new claim concerns their spectral synthesis and uniform crossover.
title: Uniform dimension-bandwidth crossover for zonal hemispherical spectral determinants
